scope: Independently authored private attachment protocol and process-lifetime peer
constraints: Standard library only; no product packages, previous implementation or captured conversation inputs
Only private attachment frames are exchanged; no MCP tool effect or model prompt is performed
Config input is bounded to 2 MiB and attachment frames to 4 KiB; fixture connection setup and reads have finite deadlines
Outputs only fixed owner, attaching, ready or rejected markers; no credentials or arbitrary response values are printed
The deliberately lingering case exercises cleanup failure; the test owns and terminates all fixture processes
